summary: IDENTITY (face-embedding) GATE + CALIBRATION BACKGROUND-JOB REFACTOR verified end-to-end. 10/10 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_identity_gate.py (96.57s). (1) POST /api/calibration now returns 200 in ~120ms with {job_id, status:'running'} — well under the 60s Cloudflare cap that used to 502 (iteration_4 HIGH issue). Polling GET /api/calibration/job/{job_id} reaches status='done' in ~90-100s and the done payload includes current_body_fat_pct (25.9), identity_all_pass=true, renders=[3] with drop_pct 5/10/15, and pairwise_distinctness with keys 5vs10/5vs15/10vs15. (2) IDENTITY GATE: each of the 3 calibration renders' qa carries identity_checked=true, identity_similarity as a real float in [-1,1], identity_pass=true, identity_mode='ok'. Direct Mongo inspection of the persisted doc: drop_pct 5 -> sim=0.8147, drop_pct 10 -> sim=0.7687, drop_pct 15 -> sim=0.6505 — all comfortably above IDENTITY_MIN=0.363; identity_mode='ok' on all three (no retry needed for this base, as expected per the review-request note). identity_all_pass=true at the job level. (3) ROUTE ORDERING NOT SHADOWED: GET /api/calibration/view?token=<jwt> returns 200 text/html (with <html> markup); with a garbage token returns 401. GET /api/calibration/job/{id} without any auth returns 401 (proving it is a distinct auth-guarded route and not being captured by /view). (4) MAIN RENDER JOB unchanged behavior: POST /api/generate returns a job_id and polling /api/generate/{job_id} reaches done; future_self_set.renders.{conservative,expected,stretch} each has path/weight_kg/body_fat_pct/what_it_takes and a qa object that ALSO carries identity_checked/identity_similarity/identity_pass. No 500/hang. (5) GET /api/files/{path}?token= returns real image bytes (PNG or JPEG magic) for all 3 calibration render paths; without a token returns 401/403. Benign cv2 warning 'Targets are not supported by the new graph engine' in logs — ignored per note. The iteration_4 HIGH bug (POST /api/calibration timing out at CF edge → 502) is FIXED by (a) the async-job pattern (immediate 200 with job_id) AND (b) parallel drops via asyncio.gather at server.py:439.

minor.issue: Carryover from iteration_4: img_bytes from the AI provider are sometimes JPEG (magic 0xFF D8 FF) but the object is always stored/served with content-type 'image/png' and a '.png' path suffix (server.py put_object call sites). Browsers still render fine; consider sniffing magic bytes to set the correct mime/extension. NOT a regression from this iteration.

action_items: None blocking. Identity gate and calibration async-job refactor are working as specified. Optional: address the carryover minor JPEG-vs-PNG mime mismatch at objstore.put_object call sites in server.py.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:407-419 — /api/calibration correctly implements the async-job pattern: inserts a job doc, spawns _run_calibration via asyncio.create_task, returns {job_id, status:'running'} immediately. Same shape as /api/generate.
server.py:429-439 — the three drops (5/10/15) are now run concurrently via asyncio.gather(*[one(d) for d in (5, 10, 15)]) — directly fixes the iteration_4 sequential-loop 502 bug.
server.py:454-457 — identity_all_pass is computed as all(r['qa'].get('identity_pass') for r in renders) and persisted on the calibration_jobs doc, exposed via /api/calibration/job/{id}.
server.py:464-469 — /api/calibration/job/{job_id} is auth-guarded (Depends(get_current_user)) and correctly filters by both id and user_id, preventing cross-user leakage.

server.py:472-495 — /api/calibration/view route is DECLARED AFTER /calibration/job/{job_id}, but FastAPI matches static path segments before parameter segments, and 'view' does not collide because /view has no {job_id} — verified live: /view?token=... returns 200 text/html and /job/anything returns 401.

ai_provider.py:140-196 — render_with_magnitude_gate does magnitude gate first, then identity gate. Identity retry uses build_render_prompt(stats, '', face_strength='low') per spec; keeps whichever (original or retry) has the higher sim. identity_pass fails-open on undetectable faces ((sim is None) or (sim >= IDENTITY_MIN)) — correct.
image_qa.py:51-58 — YuNet + SFace models loaded lazily and cached at module scope; correct.
image_qa.py:86-97 — face_similarity returns None on any failure (missing face, decode error), so identity_checked can be false without blocking the pipeline. Good default.
image_qa.IDENTITY_MIN=0.363 matches OpenCV's SFace recommendation for cosine same-identity threshold.
